# v2 Requirements Quality Checklist: Paper Triage Assistant

**Purpose**: Validate the quality (completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability) of the v2 amendment requirements FR-008..FR-014 and SC-002, SC-003, SC-006..SC-008.
**Created**: 2026-10-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [contracts/api.md](../contracts/api.md), [docs/design/brief-v2-redesign.md](../../../docs/design/brief-v2-redesign.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Marking `[x]` means the reviewer judged the requirements-quality criterion satisfied; it does not mean implementation is complete. Tester ticked the items below on 2026-10-01 at the orchestrator's request, only where spec/contract text plus browser evidence (docs/qa/final.md v2 section) support them; unticked items are open gaps or need a spec decision. Wave D implementation evidence is in `docs/qa/wave-d.md`.

## Chat scope (FR-008, FR-009, FR-010, SC-002, SC-003)

- [x] CHK001 Is "current result set" defined precisely enough (first page plus load-more pages, display order, max 50) to be implemented identically by UI and API? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Key Entities]
- [x] CHK002 Is the behavior when the client sends a stale or unknown paper id (not stored) specified? [Edge Case, contracts/api.md POST /api/chat]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the outcomes for "answerable", "partially answerable" and "not answerable" questions distinguished, or is partial coverage left undefined? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the mock-mode answering rule ("shares a content word", >= 4 letters, stop-word list) specified deterministically enough to write tests without reading the code? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the rule for which paper is cited when several set papers match a mock question defined ("first such paper")? Does that choice conflict with expectations that a question naming a paper by title cites that paper? [Ambiguity, contracts/api.md]
- [x] CHK006 Is "out-of-scope test questions" in SC-003 enumerated (general question, paper outside set, empty set) so 100% is measurable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK007 Is the dropped-citation behavior (removed vs flagged to the user) stated consistently between FR-009 and the contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK008 Are chat requirements defined for the interval while a triage run is in flight (set not yet final)? [Coverage, Gap, brief D18]
- [x] CHK009 Is the UI scope-line copy requirement consistent with the v2 scope (per-search) rather than the old "top 10 stored papers" wording, and is the transition rule between them stated? [Consistency, brief D23]

## Searching status (FR-012, SC-006)

- [ ] CHK010 Is "appearing within 300 ms" reconciled with "visible while a search is pending" for requests that finish in under 300 ms? [Conflict, Spec §FR-012, SC-006]
- [ ] CHK011 Are "static under reduced motion" and the verb-rotation interval under reduced motion quantified? [Clarity, brief D17]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the accessible announcement content (start, per-minute, completion, failure) specified for every terminal state including load-more? [Completeness, brief D16]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the treatment of other page regions during a run (empty-state block, prior list, chat, submit/query controls) fully specified, including whether the empty-state message stays visible under the working card? [Gap, brief D18]
- [ ] CHK014 Are contrast requirements stated as measurable ratios for the indicator surface and text (cream surface, muted text, disabled button)? [Measurability, brief D1 contrast table]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the "no progress implied" constraint (no percent, no bar) stated as a testable requirement? [Measurability, brief section 0 anti-goals]

## Source links (FR-014, SC-007)

- [ ] CHK016 Are link requirements defined for results with no abs_url and no pdf_url (failed fetch, derived-id PDFs)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK017 Is link label text and accessible name specified so SC-007 ("2 links / 1 link") can be counted objectively? [Clarity, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the safety attribute set for new-tab links (rel) required, not only "open in a new tab"? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK019 Is the server-derived URL rule (arxiv -> abs/pdf from id, pdf -> original URL) consistent between FR-014, Key Entities and the contract for stored results? [Consistency, contracts/api.md]

## Load 5 more (FR-013, SC-008)

- [x] CHK020 Is the interaction between source-side drift (new papers published between pages) and "never a duplicate" defined? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK021 Is "at most 5 papers" reconciled with pages where some papers fail triage or are deduplicated (does the control still count them against has_more)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, contract has_more]
- [x] CHK022 Is the 50-paper cap behavior consistent across FR-008 (chat max 50), FR-013 (hide control) and the contract (offset <= 1000)? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK023 Are the offset rules for ID-only, URL-only and mixed topic+ID queries all stated (mixed currently rejected only via "contains any item")? [Completeness, contracts/api.md POST /api/triage]
- [x] CHK024 Is page reload behavior (offset after stored-results reload, topic empty) defined for the load-more control? [Coverage, contracts/api.md GET /api/papers]
- [ ] CHK025 Are error-state and retry requirements for load-more specified, including whether the previous list stays interactive? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, brief D19]

## Redesign and test requirements (FR-012, SC-004)

- [ ] CHK026 Are the deliberate deviations from DESIGN.md recorded in one authoritative place, and does the spec state precedence between DESIGN.md and the brief? [Consistency, brief section 0]
- [ ] CHK027 Is SC-004 ("real-browser tests pass offline") satisfiable when no browser binary is installed (skip policy defined)? [Assumption, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK028 Is a requirement defined for the static-analysis (impeccable detect) gate, including how false positives are waived? [Gap]

## Notes

- Check items off by reviewer judgement only. `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state and does not modify markers.
- Open questions surfaced during wave D testing: CHK005 (mock cites first keyword match, not the best match), CHK009 (scope-line copy is still the pre-v2 text until T040), CHK013 (empty-state block stays visible under the working card on a first run).
- v2 final pass (2026-10-01): CHK009 resolved in implementation (scope line is per-search: "Chatting about N papers from this search.", "from your last run." after reload, "Run a search first. ..." when empty). CHK013: implementation hides the empty-state block while a run is in flight (spec still silent). CHK011: under reduced motion the verb text swaps every 5 s with no animation, while FR-012 says "static"; spec and implementation differ in wording. CHK028: `npx impeccable detect` now reports 3 findings (2 known false positives plus `side-tab` on `.paper--new`); no waiver rule exists.
